ticket.title: Add Go, C and C++ extractors to miter so the polyglot taxonomy matches the documented language set
ticket.description: CONTRACTS.md advertised Go, C and Cpp as first-class languages, but miter's PolyglotLanguage (the suite's real taxonomy: Rust, TypeScript, Tsx, JavaScript, Python, Sql, Html, Css, Markdown, Dockerfile, Yaml, Hcl, Env) implements none of them, so the documented set was aspirational. Under the GB-143 decision the wire Language now mirrors miter's 13 implemented formats at lowercase; when a Go/C/C++ extractor lands it adds the variant to PolyglotLanguage and to gaugeblock-contracts in the same change (additive, pre-release patch). tree-sitter-go / tree-sitter-c / tree-sitter-cpp provide the grammars (all C-compiled, so they belong to miter, never to gaugeblock-contracts).
